comments.comment: What is the latest commit of your master ?
This is the latest commit in my master https://github.com/kavinkumarks/zeppelin/commit/e6f51e7183bf44778c9eb7948a12dcb196c4d31b

Could someone help me on this as I am struck with this?

Kavin

I can ran it successfully using the latest master. Can you rebase it to the latest commit and try again ?
BTW, how do you build your zeppelin ?

Just now I have rebased my master (https://github.com/kavinkumarks/zeppelin) and built it with "mvn clean install -Drat.skip=true -DskipTests" but still getting the same error.Please let me know if I need to provide any more details.
Please enable spark-2.0 profile, use this command "mvn clean package -Pspark-2.0 -Ppyspark -Psparkr -DskipTests"
I tried it too but still getting the same error.BTW, isn't spark-2.0 the default profile as in zeppelin-spark-dependencies_2.10/pom.xml ?

Finally, made it to work by running "mvn clean package -Pscala-2.11 -DskipTests". It seems that the default scala version chosen is 2.10 which causes the issue.Should we change the default version in the main pom.xml?

To give more insight about the NPE on SparkInterpreter.createSparkSession(SparkInterpreter.java:308), the error happens because the variable outputDir is not initialized.On debugging it further, found that when the flow goes through SparkInterpreter.open() the if condition for Scala 2.10 is executed instead of the other where the outputDir is initialized.On building the maven with scala 2.11 profile the problem went away.

I also meet this problem today. I use the external spark, build the spark-2.0 with scala-2.10 at first, then build the zeppelin-0.6.1 with scala-2.10.
sudo mvn clean package -Pbuild-distr -DskipTests -Pspark-2.0 -Phadoop-2.6 -Pyarn -Pscala-2.10
